units.source_text: 百无聊赖之时，回思往事，遗恨实多，但安得一一面告？”

en.t: In moments of utter boredom, when I think back on the past, I have so many regrets, but how could I tell them all to you face to face?"

units.source_text: 右近趁无人在旁时将信交与玉鬘。

en.t: When no one else was nearby, Ukon handed the letter to Tamakazura.
Tamakazura read the letter and began to cry.

units.source_text: 她真心感到：相别越久，想起了源氏太政大臣的模样越是觉得可恋。

en.t: She truly felt that the longer they were apart, the more dearly she longed for the image of Genji, the Grand Minister.

units.source_text: 只因不是生身父亲，未便公然地说“啊，我怀念你，很想见你！”

en.t: Yet because he was not her real father, she could not openly say, "Ah, I miss you and want so much to see you!"

units.source_text: 但心中正在考虑如何可以和他会面，不胜惆怅。

en.t: Still, she kept wondering in her heart how she might meet him, and she was overcome with melancholy.

units.source_text: 源氏曾屡次对玉鬘起不良之心，使玉鬘感到不快，

en.t: Genji had more than once harbored improper desires toward Tamakazura, making her feel uneasy,

units.source_text: 但她不曾把此事告诉右近，只在自己心中烦恼。

en.t: but she had never told Ukon about it and had only suffered over it in her own heart.

units.source_text: 然而右近早已约略窥知。

en.t: Even so, Ukon had already sensed something of it.

units.source_text: 只是两人关系究竟如何，右近至今还是莫名其妙。

en.t: But as for what the relationship between the two of them really was, Ukon still could not make any sense of it.

units.source_text: 写回信时，玉鬘说道：“我写这信，多难为情！

en.t: As she wrote her reply, Tamakazura said, "It is terribly embarrassing for me to write this letter!
But if I do not answer, that would be rude as well."
